title: Turkey to the UK (England): Skilled Worker visa
disclaimer: An illustration, not tax or immigration advice. Immigration rules, fees and processing times change often. Each point below shows how it was verified and when; check it on GOV.UK, or with a regulated immigration adviser, before acting on it. Immigration costs are shown separately and are never added to the employment-cost estimate.

tailoring_questions.text: How many years should the visa cover?
tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: The health surcharge and the Immigration Skills Charge are charged per year, and the application fee is higher for a visa of more than 3 years. This is normally the assignment length; a single grant lasts up to 5 years, so a longer assignment needs an extension.

tailoring_questions.text: Will the applicant apply from outside the UK or from inside it?
tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: Fees and decision times differ. An employee moving from Turkey normally applies from outside the UK.

tailoring_questions.text: Does the UK employer already hold a sponsor licence for Skilled Workers?
tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: Without a licence the employer must apply for one first: £1,682 for a medium or large sponsor or £611 for a small or charitable one, and about 8 weeks, which usually becomes the longest part of the timeline.

tailoring_questions.text: Is the UK employer a medium or large sponsor, or a small or charitable one?
tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: Decides the sponsor licence fee and the rate of the Immigration Skills Charge; small and charitable sponsors pay less.

tailoring_questions.text: Will a partner apply as a dependant (0 or 1)?
tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: Each dependant pays their own application fee and health surcharge, needs their own documents, and needs extra funds unless the sponsor certifies maintenance.

tailoring_questions.text: How many children under 18 will apply as dependants?
tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: Each child pays their own application fee and the child rate of the health surcharge, and extra funds apply unless the sponsor certifies maintenance.

tailoring_questions.text: Has the applicant lived in Turkey, or another country on the TB test list, for 6 months or more immediately before applying?
tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: Residents of listed countries, which include Turkey, need a TB test certificate from an approved clinic before they apply.

tailoring_questions.short_label: Who employs the worker in the UK
tailoring_questions.text: Will the UK entity employ the worker, or will the Turkish employer keep the employment and post the worker?

options.label: The UK entity employs the worker
The Turkish employer posts the worker

tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: The Skilled Worker route assumes the UK entity is the employer. If the Turkish employer posts the worker, a different route may be the relevant one, and the social security position may differ.

tailoring_questions.text: How will the applicant show English at level B2?

options.label: A degree taught in English, confirmed by Ecctis
Nationality of a majority English-speaking country

tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: Decides whether a test is needed, with its cost and lead time, or other evidence instead.

tailoring_questions.text: Will the sponsor certify maintenance on the Certificate of Sponsorship?
tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: If not, the applicant must show £1,270, plus amounts for any dependants, held for 28 consecutive days before applying.

tailoring_questions.text: Is the job in education, healthcare or social care?
tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: Jobs in listed education, health and social care occupations need a criminal record certificate.

tailoring_questions.text: What is the SOC 2020 occupation code for the job?
tailoring_questions.why_it_matters: The occupation code decides whether the job is eligible (RQF level 6 or above) and its going rate, which can be higher than £41,700.
Turkish nationals need a visa for this move. Nationals of majority English-speaking countries meet the English requirement without a test.

routes_note.title: Which route this covers
routes_note.text: This guidance covers the Skilled Worker route. It assumes the UK entity employs the worker and assigns the Certificate of Sponsorship.

routes_note.title: If the Turkish employer posts the worker
routes_note.text: If the Turkish employer keeps the employment and posts the worker to the UK, the Global Business Mobility Senior or Specialist Worker route may be the relevant one instead. It has different salary rules and does not lead to settlement. Who employs the worker also bears on the social security position (UK National Insurance or continued Turkish cover). This is a note, not a decision: an immigration adviser should confirm the route.

requirements.title: Job offer from a licensed sponsor
requirements.text: The applicant needs a job offer from a UK employer that holds a Home Office sponsor licence.

requirements.title: Certificate of Sponsorship
requirements.text: The sponsor assigns a Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS), an electronic record with a reference number that the applicant quotes in the application.

requirements.title: Eligible occupation at RQF level 6
requirements.text: The job must be on the list of eligible occupations at RQF level 6 (graduate level) or above. This has applied to new applications since 22 July 2025. The occupation code decides it.

requirements.title: Salary threshold, basic pay only
requirements.text: The salary must be at least £41,700 a year or the going rate for the occupation, whichever is higher. Only guaranteed basic gross pay counts: allowances (including housing and cost-of-living allowances), benefits in kind, bonuses, and employer pension or National Insurance contributions do not count.

requirements.title: English at level B2
requirements.text: For applications made on or after 8 January 2026, English must be at CEFR level B2 in reading, writing, speaking and listening, proven by a Secure English Language Test from an approved provider or by a degree taught in English with Ecctis confirmation.

requirements.title: Valid passport
requirements.text: A valid passport or other travel document showing identity and nationality.

requirements.title: Online application and biometrics
requirements.text: The application is made online from outside the UK, after which the applicant gives fingerprints and a photograph (biometrics) at a visa application centre.

requirements.title: Immigration Health Surcharge
requirements.text: The Immigration Health Surcharge is paid as part of the application, for each year of the visa (see the costs table).

requirements.title: TB test certificate
requirements.text: A tuberculosis (TB) test certificate from a Home Office-approved clinic is needed when the applicant has lived in a listed country, which includes Turkey, for 6 months or more immediately before applying. In Turkey the approved clinics are in Istanbul and Ankara.
requirements.why_it_applies: The applicant has lived in Turkey, a country on the TB test list, for 6 months or more immediately before applying.

requirements.title: Criminal record certificate
requirements.text: Needed only for jobs in listed occupations in education, health and social care: a certificate from each country the applicant has lived in for 12 months or more in the last 10 years.
requirements.why_it_applies: The job is in education, healthcare or social care, where listed occupations need a criminal record certificate.

requirements.title: Maintenance funds
requirements.text: The applicant must have held £1,270 for 28 consecutive days before applying, unless the sponsor certifies maintenance on the Certificate of Sponsorship.
requirements.why_it_applies: The sponsor will not certify maintenance, so the applicant must show the funds.

requirements.title: Reduced salary thresholds
requirements.text: Lower salary thresholds exist for new entrants (from £33,400), for jobs that need a relevant PhD, and for occupations on the Immigration Salary List. This tool states that they exist; it does not decide whether one applies.

requirements.title: Partner as a dependant
requirements.text: A partner may apply as a dependant, paying their own application fee and health surcharge. Unless the sponsor certifies maintenance, a further £285 must be shown.
requirements.why_it_applies: A partner will apply as a dependant.

requirements.title: Children as dependants
requirements.text: Children under 18 may apply as dependants, each paying their own application fee and the child rate of the health surcharge. Unless the sponsor certifies maintenance, £315 must be shown for the first child and £200 for each further child.
requirements.why_it_applies: At least one child will apply as a dependant.

requirements.title: No dependants for Temporary Shortage List jobs
requirements.text: Workers sponsored in occupations on the Temporary Shortage List (below RQF level 6) cannot bring dependants. This matters only if the job is one of those occupations.

employer_responsibilities.title: Hold a sponsor licence
employer_responsibilities.text: Hold a sponsor licence before assigning any Certificate of Sponsorship. Since the April 2024 rule change a licence no longer needs renewing every 4 years.

employer_responsibilities.title: Genuine vacancy
employer_responsibilities.text: Sponsor only a genuine vacancy that meets the skill and salary rules, with the job described accurately on the certificate.

employer_responsibilities.title: Pay at least the threshold in every pay period
employer_responsibilities.text: Pay at least the salary threshold, from guaranteed basic pay, in every pay period, not just on average over the year.

employer_responsibilities.title: Right-to-work checks
employer_responsibilities.text: Check the worker's right to work before employment starts, using the Home Office online service and the worker's share code, and keep a dated record of the check.

employer_responsibilities.title: Record keeping
employer_responsibilities.text: Keep the records the sponsor guidance requires for each sponsored worker, such as contact details, right-to-work evidence, and pay and absence records.

employer_responsibilities.title: Report changes within 10 working days
employer_responsibilities.text: Report specified changes on the sponsor management system within 10 working days, for example a worker not starting, unauthorised absence, a change of job or salary, or the employment ending.

employer_responsibilities.title: Key personnel
employer_responsibilities.text: Appoint suitable key personnel (an Authorising Officer, a Key Contact and at least one Level 1 User) to run the licence on the sponsor management system.

employer_responsibilities.title: Compliance visits
employer_responsibilities.text: Cooperate with Home Office compliance visits, which can happen before or after a licence is granted and may be unannounced.

employer_responsibilities.title: Costs the worker must not bear
employer_responsibilities.text: The Immigration Skills Charge must never be recovered from the worker. Since 31 December 2024 the sponsor licence fee and the Certificate of Sponsorship fee cannot be passed to the worker either.

stages.title: Apply for a sponsor licence
stages.description: The employer applies for a Skilled Worker sponsor licence, appoints key personnel and sends supporting documents. Needed only when no licence is held.
stages.alternative_note: The range assumes the standard service (about 8 weeks). A priority service, decided in about 10 working days for about £750 extra, may be available in limited numbers.

stages.title: Define the job: occupation code and salary check
stages.description: Match the job to a SOC 2020 occupation code on the eligible occupations list, confirm it is RQF level 6 or above, and check the guaranteed basic salary against £41,700 and the occupation's going rate. Can run while a licence application is pending.

stages.title: Assign the Certificate of Sponsorship
stages.description: The sponsor assigns the Certificate of Sponsorship on the sponsor management system and gives the reference number to the applicant. The certificate must then be used within 3 months.

stages.title: English test at B2
stages.description: Book and sit a Secure English Language Test at level B2 with an approved provider, and receive the result. Can start as soon as the move is agreed.

stages.title: TB test
stages.description: Attend an approved clinic in Istanbul or Ankara for a chest X-ray and receive the certificate. The certificate is valid for 6 months, so time it to fall within 6 months of the application.

stages.title: Gather documents
stages.description: Collect the passport, evidence of English, any funds evidence and dependants' documents, with certified translations of anything not in English or Welsh.

stages.title: Online application and biometrics
stages.description: Complete the online application with the certificate reference, pay the fee and health surcharge, and attend a visa application centre for biometrics. Appointment availability drives the range.

stages.title: Home Office decision (outside the UK)
stages.description: A decision is usually made within 3 weeks of the biometrics appointment for an application from outside the UK.
stages.alternative_note: Where available, priority (about 5 working days, about £500) or super priority (by the next working day, about £1,000) shortens this stage.

stages.title: Home Office decision (inside the UK)
stages.description: A decision is usually made within 8 weeks for an application from inside the UK. The lower end of the range is an assumption, not a published figure.
stages.alternative_note: Where available, priority or super priority services shorten this stage for an extra fee.

stages.title: Travel and start work
stages.description: The worker travels to the UK (normally no earlier than 14 days before the certificate's start date), the employer completes the right-to-work check, and employment starts.

documents.title: Valid passport or travel document
documents.text: A current passport or other valid travel document, with a blank page for a vignette if one is issued.
documents.why_it_applies: Every Skilled Worker application needs one.

documents.title: Certificate of Sponsorship reference number
documents.text: The reference number the sponsor gives the applicant after assigning the certificate.
documents.why_it_applies: Every Skilled Worker application quotes one.

documents.title: Job details
documents.text: Job title, annual salary, occupation code, and the employer's name and sponsor licence number, as shown on the certificate.
documents.why_it_applies: The application asks for them for every Skilled Worker.

documents.title: Certified translations
documents.text: A certified translation of any document that is not in English or Welsh.
documents.why_it_applies: Turkish-language documents, such as civil records, need a translation.

documents.title: Secure English Language Test result at B2
documents.text: A pass at CEFR level B2 in a Secure English Language Test from an approved provider.
documents.why_it_applies: English will be shown with a test, and applications from 8 January 2026 need level B2.

documents.title: Degree taught in English, with Ecctis confirmation
documents.text: The degree certificate and Ecctis confirmation that the degree was taught in English.
documents.why_it_applies: English will be shown with a degree taught in English instead of a test.

documents.title: No separate English evidence
documents.text: The passport shows nationality of a majority English-speaking country, which meets the English requirement.
documents.why_it_applies: The applicant is a national of a majority English-speaking country.

documents.title: TB test certificate
documents.text: A certificate from a Home Office-approved clinic in Istanbul or Ankara, issued within 6 months before the application.
documents.why_it_applies: The applicant has lived in Turkey, a country on the TB test list, for 6 months or more immediately before applying.

documents.title: TB test certificates for dependants
documents.text: Dependants who have also lived in Turkey usually need their own certificate; the clinic advises on the checks for young children.
documents.why_it_applies: Dependants are applying and the family has lived in a TB-test country.

documents.title: Criminal record certificate
documents.text: A certificate from each country the applicant has lived in for 12 months or more in the last 10 years.
documents.why_it_applies: The job is in education, healthcare or social care, where listed occupations need one.

documents.title: Evidence of funds
documents.text: Bank statements showing £1,270 held for 28 consecutive days, ending no more than 31 days before the application.
documents.why_it_applies: The sponsor will not certify maintenance on the certificate.

documents.title: Evidence of funds for dependants
documents.text: Further funds held for 28 days: £285 for a partner, £315 for the first child and £200 for each further child.
documents.why_it_applies: Dependants are applying and the sponsor will not certify their maintenance.

documents.title: Evidence of the relationship with the partner
documents.text: A marriage or civil partnership certificate, or evidence of having lived together for at least 2 years.
documents.why_it_applies: A partner will apply as a dependant.

documents.title: Children's birth certificates
documents.text: A birth certificate for each child, and evidence of the other parent's consent where only one parent is coming to the UK.
documents.why_it_applies: At least one child will apply as a dependant.

costs.label: Sponsor licence fee
costs.description: One-off fee for a Skilled Worker sponsor licence. Payable only when the employer does not already hold a licence.
costs.notes: Fee reported from 8 April 2026. A licence no longer needs renewing (rule change April 2024).

costs.label: Sponsor licence priority service
costs.description: Optional faster decision on a licence application, in about 10 working days, offered in limited numbers.

costs.label: Certificate of Sponsorship fee
costs.description: Fee the sponsor pays to assign a Certificate of Sponsorship.
costs.notes: £525 since 9 April 2025 (search-confirmed); reported unchanged for 2026. Cannot be passed to the worker since 31 December 2024.

costs.label: Immigration Skills Charge
costs.description: Charge the sponsor pays when assigning the certificate: an amount for the first 12 months, then an amount for each further 6 months of the visa.
costs.notes: Rates from 16 December 2025. Must never be recovered from the worker.

costs.label: Visa application fee (main applicant)
costs.description: Home Office fee for the Skilled Worker application, depending on visa length and where the application is made.

costs.label: TB test (approved clinic in Turkey)
costs.description: Clinic fee for the chest X-ray and certificate, paid in Turkish lira, per person tested.
costs.notes: Indicative range in lira; not converted and not included in the subtotals.

costs.description: Fee for a Secure English Language Test at B2; varies by provider and test.
costs.notes: Typical range; not included in the subtotals.

maintenance_funds.text: Money the applicant must show has been held for 28 consecutive days before applying. It is not a fee and not a cost to the employer.

timeline_notes.text: A decision usually takes up to 3 weeks from outside the UK and up to 8 weeks from inside the UK, counted from the biometrics appointment.
The applicant can apply up to 3 months before the job start date stated on the Certificate of Sponsorship.
A Certificate of Sponsorship must be used in an application within 3 months of being assigned.
A TB certificate is valid for 6 months, so the test is best taken close to the application date.
The worker can normally travel to the UK up to 14 days before the start date on the certificate.
A single Skilled Worker grant lasts up to 5 years; a longer assignment needs an extension applied for from inside the UK.
